sahneler.metin: At Russia's largest hydro plant, a turbine burst out of its housing.
Water flooded the turbine hall, and seventy five people were killed.
The turbine had vibrated heavily for years.
The bolts holding its cover down were fatigued.
When they failed, water pressure pushed the turbine up and out.
Hydro plants reviewed vibration limits and bolt inspections.

aciklama:
Sayano-Shushenskaya flooded when a turbine was forced out of its housing. The cause: fatigue failure of turbine cover studs under long-term vibration, letting water pressure eject the rotor.
